headlines.text: On this day in 2026, there was a changing of the guard for the AEW International Title as Konosuke Takeshita vs. Kazuchika Okada battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 9.52 ? an all-time classic ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. After months of a slow-building grudge, Takeshita finally toppled Okada for the AEW International Title ? only for a returning Kyle Fletcher to blindside his former Don Callis Family stablemate moments later.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2026, the AEW World Heavyweight Title found a new home as MJF vs. Darby Allin battled it out, appearing on Double or Nothing, rated 8.99 ? a war that left everything in the ring ? ending the champion's reign at 8 defenses.
